```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The report reads outputs/, data/processed/ and data/external/; run R/run_all.R
# first, then render with `Rscript report/render.R`. Every result in the text
# (estimates, p-values, counts) comes from those files, so it cannot drift from
# the pipeline. Method settings fixed by design (distance thresholds, permutation
# and bootstrap counts) are typed, and match R/00_setup.R and the stage scripts.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dpi = 300)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(sf) })
ROOT <- normalizePath("..", winslash = "/")
fig  <- function(name) file.path(ROOT, "outputs", "figures", name)
tab  <- function(name) readr::read_csv(file.path(ROOT, "outputs", "tables", name), show_col_types = FALSE)
proc <- function(name) readr::read_csv(file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", name), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Inline formatting: pct(0.0971) -> "9.7%", num(1234.5) -> "1,235", p_fmt(0.0004) -> "< 0.001".
pct   <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
num   <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
p_fmt <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
p_cell <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))  # for table cells
CAT_LAB <- c(food_services = "Food services", retail = "Retail goods", health = "Health",
             food_retail = "Food retail", education = "Education", recreation = "Recreation")
```
